hypotheses.subject: io-pay
hypotheses.summary: From 2026-11-03T00:36:00Z the third-party card provider io-pay (api.io-pay.example, owned by IO Payments Ltd) began returning 503 on /v1/shoppers/<id>/card. The account page needs that call, so about 100% of its requests failed. io-shop itself is healthy and unchanged.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - PaymentProviderFailed: api.io-pay.example returned 503 for /v1/shoppers/shopper-45679-10-0/card at src/io_shop/payment_provider.py:95
io-pay: third-party, owned by IO Payments Ltd, at api.io-pay.example - called while the account page renders
error_rate 0.945 then 1.0 with p50 about 2045ms from 2026-11-03T00:36:00Z; before that it was baseline with only ClientDisconnected errors
No changes recorded in the window, the rollout has converged, and cpu_limit_cores stays at 3.0 throughout
